card: This PR speeds up wallet unit test execution by consolidating mock wallet creation into a shared NewWallet helper and setting keypool_size to 1, avoiding the pre-derivation of the default 1000 keys. It reduces test turnaround times for developers and CI runs. The author reports that coinselector_tests runtime drops from 8.26 s to 3.35 s, alongside smaller reductions across other wallet test suites.
changed_since_previous: CreateSyncedWallet was simplified to take NodeContext directly rather than separate chain and active chain references, removing redundant chainman locking at call sites.
evidence: Author benchmarks in PR description showing coinselector_tests runtime drops from 8.26 s to 3.35 s, wallet_tests from 2.10 s to 1.68 s, spend_tests from 0.59 s to 0.18 s, and group_outputs_tests from 0.33 s to 0.12 s.
problem: Wallet unit test suites repeatedly instantiate mock descriptor wallets that pre-derive the default 1000-key keypool, adding unnecessary CPU overhead to local developer test runs and CI.

risk.why: The changes only affect test helper utilities and wallet unit test fixtures.

summary: Consolidates mock wallet creation into a shared NewWallet test utility that sets m_keypool_size = 1 before generating descriptor keypool managers. Simplifies CreateSyncedWallet to take NodeContext directly, removing boilerplate chain and lock handling from individual test cases.
